energy_community.title: Energy community (Energiegemeinschaft)
energy_community.description:
An energy community produces power locally, which is used before power is drawn from the public grid. Enable this to add two extra sensors per metering point: Eigendeckung (covered by the community) and Restnetzbezug (taken from the grid). The main sensor keeps reporting your full consumption.

The community split is published a while after the consumption itself. Until it arrives, Restnetzbezug matches your full consumption and is corrected automatically once the values appear.
